FONDUTA - Cream made by melting "fontina" cheese from the Val d'Aosta with butter, egg-yolks, milk and white truffles
BUCCELLATO - Cake in the shape of rings or rolls, made with pastry-flour and sugar, vanilla, aniseed and currants
BUSECCA - Highly spiced veal tripe with beans
CACIUCCO - Fish stew
CALCIONI - Ravioli browned and baked in the oven
Frittelle - Rings of leavened pasta, fried and sprinkled with sugar, served hot
Taccula -  A dish of blackbirds or thrushes cooked with their entrails and wrapped in myrtle-leaves from which they absorb the aroma
Polenta e Osei - Polenta in which small birds are immersed, flavoured with the gravy of the latter
Fritto Misto - Mixed grill of liver, heart, brains, veal steaks, "cocks-comb" pasta, chip potatoes, artichokes, marrow and cauliflower
Porchetta - Suckling pig cooked whole in the oven after having been well salted and spiced
Taggliatelle - Thin slices of pasta made with eggs, and flavoured with ragout
CALZONE - Envelope of pasta containing anchovies, mackerel, and various kinds of vegetables
CANNELONI - Pasties of flaky pastry containing minced meat or fish
Ravioli - Pasta made with eggs stuffed with meat or with vegetables and buttermilk curd
Gnocchi - Dumplings of potatoes and flour or of semolina cooked in milked or salted water, flavoured with ragout or with flour, milk, eggs and parmesan cheese
Torrone - Sweet made of honey, almonds and nuts
CAPONATA - Made of ship's biscuits soaked in water to soften them, with anchovies, onions, slices of fresh tomatoes, basil, garlic, chillis and olives, the whole flavoured with salt, pepper, oil and vinegar
Torta Pasualina - A stuffing of green vegetables, (spinach, artichokes, etc), highly seasoned with curdled milk and eggs, between numerous layers of paper-thin pasta
Recchietta -  A type of pasta asciutta
CAPPELLETTI - Pasties of pasta mad with eggs in the shape of a hat, and filled with raw meat
Risi e bisi - Minestra of rice, peas, onion, bacon and ham. Some varieties contain giblets, mutton, turkey, etc.
Tortellini - Light envelopes of pasta filled with pork, turkey, ham, eggs, cheese and spices. Served in broth or "dry".
Gorgonzola - Cheese of two qualities: green, soft and translucent, piquant with a green veining due to the cultivation of a special mould; and white, with characteristics similar to the foregoing, but sweeter and without the mould
Risotto alla Certosina - Minestra of rice with ragout of crayfish mushrooms and peas
Trenette -  Lasagne flavoured with pesto
italy
CARCIOFI ALLA GIUDA - (Jerusalem Artichokes), fried in oil

Mortadella - Spiced pork sausage-meat
Triglie alla Livornese - Rock-mullet with chopped garlic, parsley and celery, cooked in oil with pepper and slices of tomato.
CASSATA ALLA SICILIANA - A sweet made of buttermilk, sugar, vanilla, chocolate, candied fruits and sweet liqueur
Incasciata - Pasta in layers with alternate slices of meat and of hard-boiled eggs
Trippa alla Romana - Ox-tripe with sauce and cheese
Pasta e Fasoi - Soup of short pastry, well-cooked beans, and pork rind
Salcicce - Highly spiced pork sausages

Pasta Beale - Small balls of pasta used in soups

Zampone - Pork, highly seasoned, made up into sausages in the skin of the forefeet.
CASTAGNACCIO - Sweet made of chestnut-flour with pine-seeds and currants
